methods.label: A-LOAM
methods.selection_note: kitti_default was the accuracy candidate in the existing sequence 07 profile comparison (lowest stored 100 m RPE and official RTE there). Its arguments are frozen; the added sequences do not select a profile.
methods.no_gt_seed_policy: These four pipelines never use per-frame GT seeding; GT is used only for the initial rigid evaluation anchor. Keep the original variant arguments verbatim, including an explicit --no-gt-seed where present.

methods.label: LF-GICP
methods.selection_note: field beta 0.25 was calibrated on sequence 00 first 500 frames against the paper dilution range, after earlier 02/08 runs exposed excessive gating. Those sequences influenced the decision to recalibrate; no added sequence influences the frozen setting.
methods.no_gt_seed_policy: These four pipelines never use per-frame GT seeding; GT is used only for the initial rigid evaluation anchor. Keep the original variant arguments verbatim, including an explicit --no-gt-seed where present.

methods.label: L-LO
methods.selection_note: cluster_cell=0.25, ground_tolerance=0.15 and max_range=80 were selected by the existing 100 m RPE sweeps on sequence 07 and previously transferred unchanged to 00/02/05/08. Sequence 01 is NA in the paper and excluded.
methods.no_gt_seed_policy: These four pipelines never use per-frame GT seeding; GT is used only for the initial rigid evaluation anchor. Keep the original variant arguments verbatim, including an explicit --no-gt-seed where present.
